title: Derived single-source Hom evaluation
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] for which the derived category D(O_Y) exists [def-pc-derived-category]. Let Q be localization of cochain complexes of sheaves of O_Y-modules. Suppose a natural isomorphism e:Hom-complex(O_Y[0],-) to the identity [def-pur-hom-complex] is given. There exists a natural isomorphism j:RHom(O_Y[0],-) to the identity [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] such that for every O_Y-module sheaf B [def-pur-sheaf-hom], every k:O_Y to B and every K-injective complex I [def-pur-kinjective-complex], there is c:Q Hom-complex(B[0],I) isomorphic to RHom(B[0],QI). The composite c.hom, RHom(k[0],QI), j_QI equals Q of Hom-complex(k[0],I) followed by e_I. No affine morphism, algebra-valued functor or adjunction is assumed.

source.place: Section 08J7 and Lemma 0A95; localization comparison and naturality

proof.text: Write I0 for the functorial K-injective replacement and eta for its augmentation. Use derivedInternalHom_comparison for this replacement. Fixing its first variable at O_Y[0], compose it with e on I0 and the inverse of Q(eta). This gives a natural isomorphism after precomposition by Q. Fully faithful precomposition by Q descends it to j on the derived category.

For a K-injective complex I, eta_I is a quasi-isomorphism between K-injectives. Hence Hom(B[0], eta_I) is a quasi-isomorphism by quasiIso_homComplex_map. Compose Q of this map with the inverse of the comparison at (B[0], I) to obtain c from the unresolved Hom complex to derived internal Hom.

Naturality of the comparison in the first variable moves precomposition by k[0] across it. The comparison at O_Y[0] cancels against its inverse in j. Naturality of the Hom-complex bifunctor moves eta across precomposition by k. Finally naturality of e moves eta across evaluation, and Q(eta) cancels with its inverse. The resulting composite is Q of precomposition by k[0] followed by e_I, as asserted. No finiteness or boundedness hypothesis is used; the zero map k, zero B, zero ring and empty scheme obey the same identities.

proof_origin.place: Section 08J7 and Lemma 0A95; localization comparison and naturality

theorem derived_single_hom_evaluation (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (e : (homComplexFunctor (R := Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf)).obj
        (op ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))) ≅ 𝟭 _) :
    ∃ j : (Functor.curry.obj
        (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf)).obj
          (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))) ≅ 𝟭 _,
      ∀ (B : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))
        (k : SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf ⟶ B)
        (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (_ : I.IsKInjective),
      ∃ c : DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (homComplex (R := Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
            ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj B) I) ≅
          (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj
            (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj B),
              DerivedCategory.Q.obj I),
        c.hom ≫ (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
            Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf).map
          (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).map k).op,
            𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) ≫
          j.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) =
            DerivedCategory.Q.map
              (((homComplexFunctor (R := Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf)).map
                (((CochainComplex.singleFunctor
                  (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).map k).op)).app I ≫
                    e.hom.app I)
